theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ r : ℕ, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M) → ∀ y ∈ M, ∃ (V : Set (Euclid m)) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid P), IsOpen V ∧ IsOpen W ∧ y ∈ W ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ V ∧ InjOn ψ V ∧ ψ '' V = W ∩ M ∧ (∀ K ⊆ W, IsCompact K → IsCompact (V ∩ ψ ⁻¹' K)) ∧ ∀ z ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ z)
